summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on managing the ClickHouse query logs, which consume significant storage space. The current practice is to let the log accumulate over a month.

It was proposed that the query log feature should either be disabled or limited in scope. Alternatives discussed included setting a Time-To-Live (TTL) for the logs, potentially limiting retention to several days or just one day's worth of data.

[p1] suggested reviewing the configuration changes required to implement TTL and asked [me] for their opinion upon waking up.
decisions: Investigate implementing a Time-To-Live (TTL) mechanism for ClickHouse query logs.
action_items: [me] to review the feasibility of setting a TTL on the query logs when available.
